column_notes.power_off_def_pts: points versus average FBS team per game; higher is better; def_pts = points prevented
column_notes.off_stats: current-season offensive metrics; higher is better
column_notes.def_stats: current-season defensive allowed metrics; lower is better
column_notes.prior_weight: share of BTB Power Rating still derived from the preseason baseline
column_notes.power_change: change in BTB Power Rating versus the previous weekly snapshot
column_notes.rank_change: national rank movement versus the previous snapshot; positive means the team moved up
